bug_semantics: Authenticated users can toggle emoji reactions on a comment by supplying only comment_id and a permitted emoji. The react() handler does not load the comment or its conversion and does not call access.can_see_comment, so a user who knows the ID of a private or otherwise invisible comment can add or remove reactions on it (CWE-862 missing authorization). Unauthorized requests should be HTTP 403.
flaw_origin: First write of the unguarded reaction sink is 4fa058f3ea7275eb340ea751ab9908a071673f94 (2026-05-14, ecrou-exact, 'add: [social] notifications, follows, reports, system logs and admin panels') in website/web/convert/convert.py react(): after syntactic comment_id and allowed-emoji checks it calls ConvertModel.react_to_comment(comment_id, current_user.id, emoji) with no visibility check; convert_core.py react_to_comment toggles CommentReaction by IDs only. Parent 45874f5d162c4dc640f1763cb9916bccaf62b261 has convert.py and convert_core.py but no def react(, react_to_comment, toggle_reaction, or CommentReaction. 672ca701b393 is a rename of convert/ to conversions/; 26ece65587f6 swaps ConversionModel.react_to_comment for comments_repo.toggle_reaction and adds visibility on other comment mutations, still leaving react() ungated until the fix.

Advisory fix a18c07c3dd4 (2026-07-22, Christian Studer, 'fix: [website] Gate emoji reactions on comment visibility', parent 959d67bd985) loads the comment, rejects missing/deleted, loads the conversion, and enforces access.can_see_comment before toggle_reaction; 403 on failure.
